annotations.title: Scan EWS code for the Graph migration

description:
FREE and instant (no AI). Static analysis of code that uses Exchange Web Services (EWS Managed API in C#/PowerShell/Java, Python exchangelib, ews-javascript-api or raw SOAP) before the Exchange Online EWS shutdown (phased since October 1, 2026, final on April 1, 2027). Lists every EWS operation with its Microsoft Graph equivalent, the authentication changes (basic auth, impersonation, EWS OAuth scopes), Graph gaps that block migration (public folders, delegates, archive), on-premises targets that are not affected, security flags and a 0-100 risk score.

Pricing: free, no API key needed.

code.description: Source code that calls EWS (max 30000 characters).
